# gilguard

> Raise a detailed error the moment an import re-enables the GIL on free-threaded Python.

## Docs

### API Reference

#### When the GIL comes back on
> What gilguard raises or warns with, and the report that comes with it.

- [GILEnabledError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/gilguard/reference/GILEnabledError.html)
- [GILReport](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/gilguard/reference/GILReport.html)
- [GILGuardWarning](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/gilguard/reference/GILGuardWarning.html)

#### Turning the guard on and off
> `import gilguard` calls install() for you. Use these to choose the action in code or to stop guarding.

- [install](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/gilguard/reference/install.html)
- [uninstall](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/gilguard/reference/uninstall.html)

#### Checking the interpreter
> Small helpers you can use with or without the guard installed.

- [is_free_threaded_build](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/gilguard/reference/is_free_threaded_build.html)
- [gil_enabled](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/gilguard/reference/gil_enabled.html)
